schemes.notes: Comprehensive official scheme guidelines covering all 18 traditional trade families (carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, etc.), three-stage verification process (Gram Panchayat/ULB, District, Screening Committee), skill upgrading, toolkit incentive (Rs. 15,000), collateral-free enterprise credit (Tranche 1 Rs. 1 lakh @ 5%, Tranche 2 Rs. 2 lakh), and digital incentive.

schemes.issuing_authority: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts, Government of India
schemes.document_title: Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019 (Gazette Notification G.S.R. 914(E))
warnings: Document is bilingual (Hindi on left pages, English on right pages); chunking should distinguish languages or target the English gazette text sections (pages 5–9).
schemes.notes: Statutory Gazette Notification G.S.R. 914(E) under Government Savings Promotion Act, 1873. Specifies age limit (girl child below 10 years), maximum 2 accounts per family (with exception for twins/triplets), deposit limits (min Rs. 250, max Rs. 1.5 lakh per fiscal year), tenure (21 years), premature closure, and withdrawal rules (up to 50% after age 18 for higher education).

schemes.issuing_authority: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
schemes.document_title: Karnataka Legislative Council Unstarred Question No. 438 Reply - Gruha Lakshmi Scheme Guidelines & Orders (GO No. WCD 70 WDC 2023)
warnings: LEGACY_FONT_ENCODING: Document uses ASCII glyph mapping from legacy Kannada desktop fonts (Nudi/Baraha layout) rather than Unicode UTF-8 Kannada characters. Text extraction yields ASCII characters (e.g., 'a$d* rbdrSefrJ'). Requires font-remapping or OCR conversion for natural language RAG.
schemes.notes: Authoritative state legislative record containing full Government Orders (GO No. WCD 70 WDC 2023 dated 20-05-2023, 06-06-2023, 12-06-2023). Specifies benefit of Rs. 2,000/month to woman head of family named on Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration card; explicitly disqualifies women or their husbands paying income tax or GST.
